file.description: The file the listing is limited to, resolved through renames to its current path.

asymmetry.description: Confidence percentages for asymmetric-coupling: one direction at least `high`, the other at most `low`.

population.description: The logical changes coupling was counted over.

eligibleChanges.description: Changes at or below the maximum changeset size: the one population behind every count.

oversizedExcluded.description: Changes above the maximum, left out on both sides of every ratio.

note.description: Set when no pair reaches the thresholds. The thresholds are never lowered.

path.description: The first file of the pair. With --file, the named file.

degree.description: Symmetric strength in percent: support over the mean of the two files' change counts.

confidence.description: Percent of changes to `path` that also touch `with`.

reverseConfidence.description: Percent of changes to `with` that also touch `path`.

support.description: Eligible logical changes touching both files.

distance.description: Folder-tree distance between the two files, as they are now.

dependent.description: With asymmetric-coupling, the file whose changes usually include the other. Otherwise null.

clearsMinimum.description: Support reaches the configured cochange.minSupport, whatever --min-support listed.
